description: Graphite sketch of recto image--horse in the lower-right corner and plate in the left-central portion of the scene.  Several dots of paint in a variety of shades have been added throughout the image.  This artwork is on the back of *Untitled (Horse)*, 1914 (CR No. 42).

title: Untitled (Horse)
